subtitleStandard: Ask anything. Your question goes to 4 AI models simultaneously.
subtitlePremium: Ask anything. 4 AI models debate your question in multiple rounds, then vote blindly on the best answer.
premiumModeBanner: PREMIUM MODE — DEEPER REASONING · BLIND VOTING · HIGHEST QUALITY ANSWER
multiModelDetail: Your prompt is sent simultaneously to GPT-4o, Claude, DeepSeek, and Grok. Each answers independently before synthesis begins.
consensusDetail: A synthesis pass analyzes where models agreed, partially overlapped, or conflicted. Color-coded: green for consensus, yellow for partial, red for conflict.
debateDetail: In Premium mode, models go through 2 rounds of debate, then vote blindly on the best answer. Majority wins, ties broken by Claude.
transparencyDetail: Every answer shows each model's individual output. Premium also shows the full debate history and how each model voted.
inputHint: ENTER TO SEND · PASTE OR CLICK ⊕ TO ATTACH · WEB FOR LIVE SEARCH
basedOn4Models: Based on 4 model responses · hover for details
feedbackPlaceholder: What's on your mind? Bug reports, feature ideas, general thoughts...
feedbackThanks: Thanks for helping improve VELE AI.
feedbackMinLength: Feedback must be at least 10 characters.
deleteAllDesc: This will permanently delete all your chats and message history. Hold the button below to confirm.
upd_mobileLayout_desc: Input bar and content now display correctly on all mobile browsers including iOS Safari
upd_ambientLighting_desc: Subtle animated purple glow in the background — dark mode only, disappears in light mode
upd_languageSupport_desc: Choose between English and German in Settings → Language
upd_infoPage_desc: New Info button in the sidebar explaining Standard vs Premium, all 4 AI models, and how VELE AI works
upd_webSearch_desc: Enable live web search directly from the input bar for real-time answers
upd_autoFocus_desc: Start typing immediately after opening a new chat — no extra click needed
upd_themeColor_desc: Browser chrome now matches the app background in both light and dark mode
upd_voteResultsFix_desc: Grok vote count and labels now clearly visible in light mode
upd_whatsNewButton_desc: Now fully visible on mobile with complete label shown
creditsNeverExpire: Credits never expire. Use them whenever you need.
deleteConfirm: Delete this chat? This cannot be undone.
signInSubtitle: 4 models answer simultaneously. One synthesized, honest answer.
signUpSubtitle: Get 3 free standard queries. No credit card required.
